capabilities: : Save state per note and table
intentEvidence: This Obsidian plugin adds two buttons that a theme cannot: one stretches the whole note to the full width of the pane, the other stretches a single table
motivation: It was made as a companion to the Ardentia theme and works with any theme.
problem: Standard note and table content is limited by the reading column width, often requiring horizontal scrolling or limiting visual impact.

relations.evidence: It was made as a companion to the Ardentia theme and works with any theme.

summary: Adds buttons to expand the entire note or individual tables to the full width of the Obsidian pane, overcoming reading column limitations.
